basic_info.description: This sleek, remodeled three level home offers modern finishes with great scale, privacy, and comfortable flow throughout the thoughtful floor plan. The main entertaining spaces on the second floor include a spacious living room with high ceilings, formal dining room, and updated kitchen offering ample cabinetry, top-of-the-line appliances, and a walk-in pantry. White oak hardwood and recessed lighting throughout, the primary suite features skylights, a connected office/sunroom, additional closet space, and an ensuite bath. An additional full bathroom with tub and a bedroom with balcony and yard access complete this level. Capturing even more natural light upstairs on the 3rd floor is a bright flex space with a view of GGB, full remodeled bathroom, skylight, and access to a expansive roof deck, ideal as a spacious private suite or indoor/outdoor exercise/play area. The ground level features an additional alcove with more closet space that opens to a family room, a full bathroom, 2-car tandem garage, a laundry room, & hallway storage with access to the landscaped backyard. The backyard features an additional structure for a workshop or artist studio. Fabulous location convenient to Marina Green, Chestnut & Fillmore shopping, dining and entertaining
